# KithMoot

> Group calls and chat over an incumbent's servers mean an operator holds the
> guest list, the history and the room state. KithMoot is a workspace with
> rooms, chat, files and calls built on Nostr, where membership is whoever
> holds the link, not an account on someone else's server.

KithMoot groups by participant rather than by connection: a phone and a
laptop from the same person are one tile with two tracks, not two strangers.
An agent joins the same link a person was sent, on the same terms, and says
it is one. It is for anyone who wants a Slack-and-Jitsi-grade workspace
without a server that can be shut down, subpoenaed or read. Live at
[kithmoot.app](https://kithmoot.app/) (app at `kithmoot.forgesworn.dev/j/`).

## Getting Started

The library is not published to the npm registry. Its workspace packages are
pinned at 0.2.0, which the registry does not carry, and `@forgesworn/fold-kit`
and `@forgesworn/signet-contacts` come from pinned GitHub commits, so an
install needs git access to GitHub. Build it from a checkout, then import
from `dist/src/index.js` (the package `exports` entry):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/forgesworn/kithmoot.git
cd kithmoot
npm ci
npm run build:lib   # writes dist/src/index.js and its declarations
```

```js
import { RoomAgent, AGENT_CHANNEL } from './dist/src/index.js'

const agent = await RoomAgent.join({ link: process.argv[2], name: 'Ada' })

agent.chat.onChange((messages) => {
  const last = messages.at(-1)
  if (last) console.log(`${last.name ?? last.participant.slice(0, 8)}: ${last.text}`)
})

await agent.chat.send('hello from a Node process')
await agent.channel(AGENT_CHANNEL).send('note for the other agents')
await agent.leave()
```

No browser is involved: `npm run agent -- join <link> --name Ada` does the
same from the command line (`npm run agent -- --help` lists every
subcommand and option).

## Key Concepts

- **Room**: a join link carries a bearer admission capability and a pinned
  inviter key in the fragment; the traffic key is returned encrypted to each
  admitted device (v1 secret links are legacy). A relay only sees opaque
  identifiers, never contents or names. A parsed link (`RoomLink`) holds
  either an `invitation` (v2 live, v3 stored group) or a legacy `secret`.
- **Participant identity**: a pubkey plus an async `signEvent`
  (`ParticipantIdentity` in `src/identity.ts`, re-exported from
  `@forgesworn/fold-kit`, where changes land); satisfied by a locally
  generated key or an external Nostr signer.
- **Device credential**: signed by the participant key, scoped to one room,
  valid twelve hours; it is what lets a device speak for that participant and
  join their existing tiles. A paired secondary's credential is minted by its
  primary.
- **Agent**: a `RoomAgent` (`src/agent.ts`) that joins a room the same way a
  browser does, with one addition: it declares that it is an agent.
- **Epoch**: a fresh room secret issued by a keeper, from which roster, chat,
  channel, descriptor and media keys are re-derived; used to remove members or
  close a room, and optionally to turn the key over on a schedule
  (`kithmoot-agent create --rekey-every`, off by default). Distinct from
  invitation rotation, which retires a link and leaves the live room alone.
  Code is in `src/epoch.ts`, re-exported from `@forgesworn/fold-kit`.

## API Surface

Main entry point: `src/index.ts` (built to `dist/src/index.js`). Link pair for
new links: `parseRoomLink` and `encodeRoomLink`, which handle every link
version. `encodeJoinUrl` and `decodeJoinUrl` read and write legacy v1
room-secret links only.

Rooms and links:

- `generateRoomSecret(): Uint8Array`: a fresh 32-byte room traffic secret
  (legacy v1 links carry it directly).
- `deriveRoom(secret: Uint8Array): { roomId: string; roomKey: Uint8Array }`:
  public room id and symmetric room key.
- `parseRoomLink(url: string): RoomLink`: read a link of any version; throws
  on a link that does not parse or carries a policy it cannot read.
- `encodeRoomLink(base: string, link: RoomLink): string`: write a link.
- `encodeJoinUrl(base: string, secret: Uint8Array, relays: string[], policy?: RoomPolicy): string`:
  legacy v1 link.
- `decodeJoinUrl(url: string): { secret: Uint8Array; relays: string[]; policy?: RoomPolicy }`:
  legacy v1 link.

Agents (headless runtime):

- `RoomAgent.join(opts: JoinRoomOptions): Promise<RoomAgent>`: join the room
  behind `opts.link` as `opts.name`. `RoomAgent.create(opts: CreateRoomOptions)`
  makes a room and keeps it (needs `base` and `name`).
- Instance surface: `chat`, `backchannel`, `transcripts` and `minutes`
  (each a `ChatLog` with `send(text)`, `messages()` and `onChange(cb)`),
  `channel(name: string): ChatLog`, `roster(): ParticipantView[]`,
  `leave(): Promise<void>`.
- `AGENT_CHANNEL` (`'agents'`), `TRANSCRIPT_CHANNEL` (`'transcript'`),
  `MINUTES_CHANNEL` (`'minutes'`): reserved channel names.

Events and history:

- `KINDS`: object of the numeric Nostr event kinds the protocol uses.
- `verifyEventUncached(event: Event): boolean`: signature check with no
  cached verdict.
- `historyImportRequest(input: { class: 'authored' | 'addressed'; person: string; kinds: readonly number[]; since: number; until: number; limit: number; cursor?: HistoryCursor }): HistoryImportRequest`:
  build a bounded request (limit at most 500).
- `importBoundedHistory(input: { relays; requests; read; now? }): Promise<{ events: Event[]; receipts: HistoryImportReceipt[] }>`:
  run bounded history import between devices.

Epochs (room rekeying):

- `deriveEpoch(epoch: { epoch: number; secret: Uint8Array }): { epoch: number; id: string; key: Uint8Array }`.
- `encodeRekeyEvent(opts: EncodeRekeyOptions): Event`: announce the next epoch.
- `hostRoomEpoch(opts: HostRoomEpochOptions): { close(): void }`: the keeper's
  epoch desk.
- `requestRoomEpoch(opts: RequestRoomEpochOptions): Promise<EpochGrant>`:
  ask the desk where the room is; resolves with a grant that is not a refusal
  and rejects with `EpochRefusedError` on a refusal.

The full list of exports, with types, is `src/index.ts`.

CLIs: `kithmoot-agent` (join a room without a browser; subcommands `create`,
`join`, `mcp`, `host`, `scribe`, `attest`), `kithmoot-context` (encrypted
context over MCP or one call: `node bin/kithmoot-context.mjs --help`),
`kithmoot-forwarder` (`server/forwarder.mjs`; configured by environment
only: `KITHMOOT_ROOM_ID`, `NOSTR_RELAYS` and one of `KITHMOOT_FORWARDER_SK` or
`KITHMOOT_FORWARDER_ROOT_SK`).

## Contributing

```bash
npm test           # unit and protocol tests, offline (builds the library first)
npm run typecheck
npm run demo       # HTTPS dev server, phone-friendly
```
